I would suggest watch The Gathering, watch all of the TV series, then watch the other movies in order. It's not exactly chronological or release, but thematically it works well. Thirdspace has a specific chronological placement mid season 4. But I find it jarring to watch as season 4 is a wild ride and a long side story is not good for the flow. River of Souls is vaguely placed towards the end of season 5. Again, it feels out of place in terms of narrative flow as the TV series is wrapping everything up and saying emotional farewells. It's also not that great. 

All the other stuff is chronologically set after the main B5 events.
